requirement: A malformed cursor or a cursor used with a different database, namespace, or filters must fail with a structured error.

inputs.contents:
#[derive(Clone, Default, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Debug)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
pub struct Filters {
    pub due: bool,
    pub retired: bool,
    pub since: Option<String>,
    pub search: Option<String>,
}
#[derive(Serialize, Deserialize)]
#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]
struct Cursor {
    database: String,
    language: String,
    filters: Filters,
    cutoff: String,
    offset: usize,
}
